summary: Ares Capital Corporation filed a Form 8-K on July 29, 2026, under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to disclose its quarterly financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026, and to announce a declared third-quarter dividend of $0.48 per share payable on September 30, 2026. The filing reports GAAP net income of $171 million and Core EPS of $0.47 per share. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation transaction. No merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other corporate event is described. The registrant is the issuer reporting standard operational results and a recurring distribution.
